prs.title: fix(runtime-dom): treat disablepictureinpicture and disableremoteplayback as boolean attributes
prs.author: ValentinYoushkevich
prs.body:
`<video :disablepictureinpicture="false">` renders `disablepictureinpicture="false"`, and the same happens for `disableremoteplayback`. Both are boolean content attributes, so the browser reads the attribute as present and keeps Picture-in-Picture or remote playback disabled. For example, [this player](components/match/WhepPlayer.vue#L1016) binds `:disablepictureinpicture="!enablePip"`, and with that binding PiP can't be turned back on. In SSR output the attribute is also rendered as `="false"`.

This is the same root cause as #15627 (`playsinline`). The DOM properties are camelCased (`disablePictureInPicture`, `disableRemotePlayback`), so the lowercase key fails the `key in el` check and goes through `patchAttr`. These two attributes are added to `specialBooleanAttrs`, which covers both the client and the SSR `isBooleanAttr` path.

Playground (3.5.44): [link](https://play.vuejs.org/#)
